limits: Not an independent participant comprehension test
Small-screen map retains horizontal scrolling rather than changing the network topology
Browser checks are manual tool-driven checks, not part of the automated test command

limitations: Own illustrative assumptions; no calibrated monetary-policy transmission or empirical psychology
Settlement accounts and matched loan principal are not full bank/central-bank balance sheets
No new credit, money creation, amortization, inflation, securities markets or depreciation
Government buffer finite; simplified external energy account does not recycle income; no perpetual equilibrium claim
World advances through browser requests; server sessions are memory-only, capped at 64; no checkpoint import or service continuing after browser close
UI transition/marker animation does not create additional postings; each sector trend uses its own vertical scale
No pedagogical validation, prediction validation or security audit
